title: Tavola — Free Bootstrap 6 Restaurant Website Template
excerpt: A free two-page Bootstrap 6 restaurant template — service-time tabbed menu with printed-menu leader dots, table booking with Datepicker and Combobox, gallery, hours and a full menu and wine list.
yoastTitle: Tavola — Free Bootstrap 6 Restaurant Website Template
yoastDesc: Free Bootstrap 6 restaurant, cafe and bistro website template with a tabbed lunch/dinner/Sunday menu, leader-dot dish rows, table booking using Datepicker and Combobox, opening hours, gallery and a full menu and wine list page.
intro: Tavola is a free, premium Bootstrap 6 website template for restaurants, bistros, trattorias, cafés and gastropubs. It pairs a full restaurant homepage — a menu tabbed by service time, the kitchen, the room, booking, hours and an FAQ — with a complete menu and wine list page.
note: For a restaurant the menu is the product, so it is the centre of the page rather than a link in the footer. It is tabbed by service using Bootstrap 6 tabs — lunch, dinner and Sunday are genuinely different menus, not one list with notes — and every dish row is set with leader dots the way a printed menu sets them. Those dots are a repeating gradient on a flexible middle cell, so they stretch to whatever gap is left and never wrap awkwardly. Booking uses the new Datepicker and two Comboboxes, and the FAQ is native <details>.
summary: Tavola is a free, premium two-page Bootstrap 6 template for restaurants, bistros and cafés. The homepage leads with a photographic hero, then a menu tabbed by service time — lunch, dinner, Sunday — with dish rows set using printed-menu leader dots and dietary tags. Below that: the kitchen with a pull quote, a room gallery mosaic, a booking form built on Datepicker and Combobox with an opening-hours panel beside it, and a getting-here section with a native details FAQ. The menu page adds the full card across four courses plus a wine list by the glass and bottle. Deep green canvas with a terracotta accent and serif dish names. ESM-only vanilla JavaScript, no build step, full light and dark mode.
features: Two pages — restaurant homepage and a full menu and wine list
Menu tabbed by service time using Bootstrap 6 tabs — lunch, dinner, Sunday
Dish rows set with printed-menu leader dots that stretch to any gap
Dietary tags (V, VG, GF) inline on dish names
Table booking with Datepicker, time and party-size Comboboxes
Opening hours panel with today's row highlighted
Room gallery mosaic with a feature tile
Native <details> FAQ covering allergies, private hire and service charge
Wine list by the glass and by the bottle on the menu page
Bootstrap 6 vendored at a pinned commit, ESM-only, no build step
